description.value: LanaLou's is an owner-operated rock n' roll eatery on Powell Street in Vancouver, celebrated for its live music, rotating art, and quirky, unpretentious decor. The 100-seat licensed restaurant serves comfort food crafted from locally sourced ingredients in a community-minded atmosphere. It is fully wheelchair accessible and operates as both a restaurant and a live music venue.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at lanalous.wixsite.com confirms the OSM address (362 Powell Street, Vancouver, BC) and phone (604-563-5055) exactly. The site identifies LanaLou's as a fully licensed 100-seat restaurant with live music and a community focus; DoorDash pickup is explicitly mentioned as takeout. No bike-specific amenities (racks, water refill, Wi-Fi) appear anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Website URL was not present in OSM tags; it was discovered with medium confidence. Address and phone match, supporting correct attribution.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible licensed restaurant with a confirmed address and active website. Useful to touring cyclists as a food and drink stop with late-night kitchen hours.
